# h2o-vibrations

H2O RHF analytic Hessian and ORCA-format normal-mode export

Generated by `scripts/regenerate_doc_examples.py` from the canonical
input `input-h2o-vibrations.py`.

## Files

- `input-h2o-vibrations.py`: input script
- `stdout.txt`: full captured stdout from the queued run
- `stderr.txt`: full captured stderr from the queued run
- `artifact-status.json`: machine-readable run status
- `output-h2o-vibrations.bibtex`
- `output-h2o-vibrations.hess`
- `output-h2o-vibrations.molden`
- `output-h2o-vibrations.out`
- `output-h2o-vibrations.population.json`
- `output-h2o-vibrations.population.txt`
- `output-h2o-vibrations.qvf`
- `output-h2o-vibrations.references`
- `output-h2o-vibrations.system`
- `output-h2o-vibrations.xyz`

## Reproduce

```sh
.venv/bin/python examples/molecular/input-h2o-vibrations.py
```
